complexity.guidance: Your dynamic programming approach uses O(n) auxiliary memory for precomputing left and right boundary arrays. You can optimize memory down to O(1) space using a two-pointer technique moving inward from both ends based on the lower boundary height.

strengths: Correctly handles edge cases where the input elevation array has fewer than 3 bars
Explicit array precomputation makes the trapped water calculation logic easy to follow
improvements: Cryptic variable names `l` and `r` should be renamed to `leftMax` and `rightMax` for better readability
Repeated Math.min/Math.max calls inside the loop could be streamlined
